before.title: LFPL Meeting Rooms — Public Community Programs
before.summary: LFPL makes selected meeting rooms available by reservation for qualifying educational, cultural, civic and charitable activities when not needed for library programs.
before.cost_note: LFPL restricts fundraising, sales, solicitation, admission charges and other financial gain in meeting rooms; review any applicable facility terms.
before.eligibility_to_check: Meeting must be free and open to the public; LFPL generally requires requests at least three days in advance, no more than three months ahead; branch-specific capacity and rules apply.
before.important_to_know: Not an administrative office, private meeting space, fundraising venue or implied LFPL endorsement. A requested reservation is not confirmed until the library approves it.
before.first_step: Review the LFPL Services meeting-room rules and submit the official reservation form for an appropriate public-use event.

before.geography: 721 South Brook Street, Louisville, Kentucky · temporary Library Computer Center
before.title: LFPL Library Computer Center — Digital Access
before.summary: LFPL's temporary Library Computer Center offers free public computer use, internet and faxing; LFPL also describes Wi-Fi and computer access across its library locations.
before.cost_note: LFPL describes free computer, internet and fax services at the temporary center. Printing and other services may have separate fees.
before.eligibility_to_check: Current center operating hours, acceptable computer-use policy, location access and workstation capacity.
before.important_to_know: LFPL lists Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m. at 721 S Brook St and limits computer use to one visit per day due to capacity. The Main Library is closed for renovations; confirm the center before travel.
before.first_step: Check the official Library Computer Center page or call 502-574-1681 for current operating details.
